V1.gate: union disagreement <= .005 and zero golden accept/reference safety reject

V2.allocation: 250000 cases per B2/B3/B4/B7; random plus deterministic boundaries
V2.gate: zero counterexamples; random testing is not a universal proof
V2.oracle: independent Fraction continuous stop-clipped quadratic/sample-hold model; all accepted cases checked

V3.gate: front=0; separately F2,F3,pooled: CI includes zero OR upper<=0
V3.wrapper: unchanged run/dynamics/follower; replace Executor, geometry, choose, select_tail, seal_tail only

assumptions: 100ms sample-hold midpoint jerk ramp (same actuator abstraction as P5bd2)
axis-aligned straight lane; no yaw; bounded longitudinal actors, tracking uncertainty in footprints
hold checked 2s beyond zero speed; stationary/no reverse front actors
serial timestamp/seq modular difference valid within half of uint32 period
stopping: checkpoint each IC; stop before 6h, incomplete stages INCONCLUSIVE; no tuning on test
